item.title: High on a hill sits this radically rebuilt mountain cottage in the Czech Republic
item.description: This cottage in the Czech Republic’s Giant Mountains involved a complete overhaul of a much-altered traditional structure, using the same scale and iconography to create a modern retreat

item.title: Nina Christen, the designer behind fashion’s most sought-after shoes, has opened her first Paris store
item.description: Wallpaper* takes a tour of the Rue de la Paix address, which sees the Swiss designer – who honed her craft at Loewe, Bottega Veneta and Dior – strip back the space to its essence to foreground her cult footwear

item.title: Colour has flavour at this new London cocktail bar
item.description: Located in Covent Garden, Cato is a double act with New York soul and plenty of British spirit

item.title: Balenciaga taps Euphoria’s Sam Levinson for A/W 2026
item.description: For his second collection with the house, creative director Pierpaolo Piccioli collaborated with the creator of the teen drama to make a statement on finding light in the darkness

item.title: A Jacques Couëlle-designed modernist home near Cannes gets an organic refresh
item.description: This experimental house in the South of France has been brought to 21st-century standards through an interior refresh by Miriam Frowein

item.title: In this serene Kyoto home, time slows down, and nature is felt at every turn
item.description: House in Narutaki has been reinvented by kooo architects, from a traditional Sukiya-style residence into a sensitive, minimalist home

item.title: An era-defining insight into the Chelsea Hotel's artistic community in 1970s New York
item.description: Long thought lost, these images by artist Albert Scopin chronicle his time at Manhattan’s Chelsea Hotel amidst the demi-monde of the city’s artists, musicians and eccentrics

item.title: Imperial Hotel Kyoto revives a former geiko theatre
item.description: A plush 55-room retreat carries forward the legacy of a 1936 landmark, weaving together centuries of history and culture

item.title: Matthieu Blazy’s sophomore Chanel collection is made for ‘women to be unapologetically who they are’
item.description: Presented in Paris this evening, Matthieu Blazy continued to mine a feeling of joy with a sophomore ready-to-wear collection which sought to take the Chanel woman from dawn to dusk – or, in the words of Coco Chanel, ‘caterpillar to butterfly’

item.title: In Luxembourg, Igshaan Adams translates his past into beautiful, large-scale works
item.description: At Mudam Luxembourg, Igshaan Adams’ exhibition Between Then Now brings together dance-made prints, sculptural ‘dust clouds’ and monumental woven works, transforming memories of apartheid-era Cape Town into shimmering, large-scale installations
